user.title: Unseenet node or council replica
user.description: Connect to the stats interface of an Unseenet node or council replica - for the Unseenet add-ons, the add-on's hostname and port 1120. Home Assistant only reads its status; it changes nothing on the node.

data_description.host: The add-on's hostname, shown on its Info tab
data_description.port: The stats port (1120 for the add-ons)
data_description.token: The token the add-on shows in its log

hassio_confirm.title: Unseenet found
hassio_confirm.description: Show the status of {name} from the {addon} add-on in Home Assistant?

reauth_confirm.title: New token for {name}
reauth_confirm.description: The token was refused - the add-on may have made a new one. Its log shows the current token.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the stats interface. Is the add-on running, and are its stats turned on?
error.unsupported_version: This node speaks a newer stats version - update the integration.
error.unknown: The answer was not a node's or a replica's stats.

abort.already_configured: This node or replica is already set up.
abort.wrong_node: That is a different node or replica.
abort.unsupported_version: This node speaks a newer stats version.
abort.unknown: The answer was not a node's or a replica's stats.

sent_hour.name: Posts sent to peers, last hour

node_warnings.title: Unseenet node {name} needs a look

replica_twin.title: Replica {name} has stopped: another copy uses its key
